nodes.name: Lemma 18
nodes.statement:
Let $\phi_1, \phi_2 \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be $1$-Lipschitz and odd, and let $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$.
    Let $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}, \mathbf{b})$ be independent random variables with $\mathbf{W}$ and $\mathbf{b}$, not $\mathbf{z}$, symmetric around their means.
    Moreover, assume that $\mathbf{W}$ has independent sub-Gaussian entries with sub-Gaussian parameters bounded by $\sigma$.
    Then there exists a universal constant $c > 0$ such that
    \begin{align}
        &\left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_1(\tfrac1{\sqrt{M}}\mathbf{W} (\phi_2 + \alpha)(\mathbf{z}) + \mathbf{b})] \right\|_2  \\
        &\qquad\le \left ( \tfrac1{\sqrt{M}}\mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{z} \right\|_2] + \left | \alpha \right | \right )\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}} + c \sigma \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}] \right\|_2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2.
    \end{align}
    with $c$ the same constant as in 17.

nodes.name: Remark 16
nodes.statement:
The symmetry condition for $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}, \mathbf{b})$ is satisfied if $\mathbf{W}$, $\mathbf{z}$, and $\mathbf{b}$ are independent and $\mathbf{W}$ and $\mathbf{b}$, not $\mathbf{z}$, are symmetric around their means.
    For such $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}, \mathbf{b})$, the symmetry condition is also satisfied for the triple $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}, \alpha \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})$
    where $\mathbf{1}$ is the vector of all ones and $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$.
    In that case, a similar conclusion holds:
    \begin{align}
        &\left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_1(\mathbf{W} (\phi_2 + \alpha)(\mathbf{z}) + \mathbf{b})] \right\|_2 \\
        &\quad= \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_1(\mathbf{W} \phi_2(\mathbf{z}) + \alpha \mathbf{W}\mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})] \right\|_2 \\
        &\quad\le  \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}\mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{z} \right\|_2] + \mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2] \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}] \right\|_2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\alpha \mathbf{W}\mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b}] \right\|_2 \\
        &\quad\le \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}\mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{z} \right\|_2] + \mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2] \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}] \right\|_2 + \left | \alpha \right | \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2 \left\| \mathbf{1} \right\|_2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2 \\
        &\quad= (\mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{z} \right\|_2 + \left | \alpha \right |\sqrt{M})\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}} + \mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2] \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}] \right\|_2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2.
    \end{align}

nodes.name: Lemma 26
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{A} \in \mathbb{R}^{I \times J}$ have independent standard Gaussian entries.
    Then
    \begin{equation}
        \mathbb{E}[\left\| \mathbf{A} \right\|^2_2]
        \le \eta_{I \lor J} (I \lor J),
    \end{equation}
    where $\eta_{I \lor J}$ takes the value $\tfrac19(37+6\sqrt{2\pi}) \in (5,6)$ if $I\lor J\ge 36$ and $4(2+\sqrt{2\pi}) \in (18,19)$ otherwise.

nodes.name: Lemma 27
nodes.statement:
Let $\phi_1,\phi_2\colon\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be $1$-Lipschitz and odd.
    Let the triple $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}_2, \mathbf{b}) \in \mathbb{R}^{M_1\times M_2} \times \mathbb{R}^{M_2} \times \mathbb{R}^{M_1}$ be (possibly dependent) random variables such that, for all Rademacher vectors $\bm{\upvarepsilon} \in \left\{ -1, 1 \right\}^{M_1}$,
    \begin{equation}
        (\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}], \mathbf{z}_2, \mathbf{b} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}])
        \overset{\text{d}}{=}
        (\operatorname{diag}(\bm{\upvarepsilon})(\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]), \mathbf{z}_2, \bm{\upvarepsilon} \circ (\mathbf{b} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}])).
    \end{equation}
    Consider $\mathbf{z}_1 = \tfrac1{\sqrt{M_2}}\mathbf{W} \phi_2(\mathbf{z}_2) + \mathbf{b}$.
    Then
    \begin{align}
        \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_1(\mathbf{z}_1) \phi_1(\mathbf{z}_1)^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
        &\le
            4\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2\, \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2^2
            )\\
        &\le
            4\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + K^2\, (\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty \lor 1)
            )
    \end{align}
    provided that $M_1 \ge 3$. 
    If $M_1 < 3$, then the inequality holds with the slightly worse constant $6$.

nodes.name: Remark 28
nodes.statement:
The symmetry condition for $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}_2, \mathbf{b})$ is satisfied if $\mathbf{W}$ and $\mathbf{b}$, not $\mathbf{z}_2$, are element-wise independent and symmetric around their means.
    For such $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}_2, \mathbf{b})$, the symmetry condition is also satisfied for the triple $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}_2, \tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})$
    where $\mathbf{1}$ is the vector of all ones and $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$.
    In that case, a similar conclusion holds:
    if instead
    \begin{equation}
        \mathbf{z}_1
            = \tfrac1{\sqrt{M_2}}\mathbf{W} (\phi_2 + \alpha)(\mathbf{z}_2) + \mathbf{b}
            = \tfrac1{\sqrt{M_2}}\mathbf{W} \phi_2 (\mathbf{z}_2) + (\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b}),
    \end{equation}
    then, if $M_1\ge 3$, by 27 
    \begin{align}
        \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_1(\mathbf{z}_1) \phi_1(\mathbf{z}_1)^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
        &\le
            4\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2\, \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b}] \right\|_2^2
            )\\
        &\le
            4\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2\, \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \tfrac{2\alpha^2}{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2 \left\| \mathbf{1} \right\|_2^2 + 2\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2^2
            )\\
        &\overset{\smash{\text{(i)}}}{\le}
            4\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2 (2 \alpha^2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty) + 2\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2^2
            )\\
        &\le
            8\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2 (\alpha^2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty) + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_2^2
            )\\
        &\overset{\smash{\text{(ii)}}}{\le}
            8\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + K^2\, ((\alpha^2 +  \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty) \lor 1)
            ) \\
        &\le
            8\sqrt{M_1}(
                \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty
                + K^2\, (\alpha^2 + 1 \lor \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty)
            )
    \end{align}
    where in (i) we use that $\left\| \mathbf{1} \right\|_2^2 = M_2$ and in (ii) we use that $\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_2^2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}] \right\|_\infty^2 \le K^2$. If $M_1<3$, then the inequality holds with the slightly worse constant of 12.

nodes.name: Lemma 29
nodes.statement:
Assume the conditions of the 27.
    Then
    \begin{align}
        \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty 
        &\le \tfrac2{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_\infty \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_1
        + \tfrac2{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
        + 2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}^2] \right\|_\infty \\
        &\le
            2(\sqrt{2}+K)^2 (1 \lor \tfrac1{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_1)
            + \tfrac2{M_2} K^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
    \end{align}
    and
    \begin{align}
        \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_1^2] \right\|_\infty 
        &\le 2 \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_\infty \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty
        + \tfrac2{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
        + 2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}^2] \right\|_\infty  \\
        &\le
            2(\sqrt{2}+K)^2 (1 \lor \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{2}^2] \right\|_\infty)
            + \tfrac2{M_2} K^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2.
    \end{align}

nodes.name: Remark 30
nodes.statement:
Like in 28, apply 29 to the triple $(\mathbf{W}, \mathbf{z}_2, \tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})$ where $\mathbf{W}$ and $\mathbf{b}$, not $\mathbf{z}_2$, are element-wise independent and symmetric around their means.
    To write down the result, we need to estimate $\left\| \mathbb{E}[(\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})^2] \right\|_\infty$.
    To begin with, note that
    \begin{align}
        (\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})^2
        &= (\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} (\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]) \mathbf{1} + \tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})^2 \\
        &\preceq 3\tfrac{\alpha^2}{M_2} ((\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]) \mathbf{1})^2 + 3\tfrac{\alpha^2}{M_2} (\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \mathbf{1})^2 + 3 \mathbf{b}^2 \\
        &\preceq 3\tfrac{\alpha^2}{M_2} ((\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]) \mathbf{1})^2 + 3\tfrac{\alpha^2}{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_\infty^2 \left\| \mathbf{1} \right\|_\infty^2 \mathbf{1} + 3 \mathbf{b}^2 \\
        &\overset{\smash{\text{(i)}}}{\preceq} 3\tfrac{\alpha^2}{M_2} ((\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]) \mathbf{1})^2 + 3\alpha^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 \mathbf{1} + 3 \mathbf{b}^2
    \end{align}
    where the squares and inequalities are element-wise and in (i) we use that $\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_\infty \le \sqrt{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}$.
    For the first term, consider the $m$\textsuperscript{th} element and use independence of the elements of $\mathbf{W}$:
    \begin{align}
        \mathbb{E}[\tfrac{1}{M_2}((\mathbf{W} - \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}]) \mathbf{1})^2]_m
        &= \textstyle
            \tfrac{1}{M_2} \mathbb{E}\big[
                \big(\sum_{m'=1}^{M_2}(W_{m,m'} - \mathbb{E}[W_{m,m'}])\big)^2
            \big] \\
        &= \textstyle
            \tfrac{1}{M_2}
                \sum_{m'=1}^{M_2} \mathbb{E}[(W_{m,m'} - \mathbb{E}[W_{m,m'}])^2] \\
        &\le \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_{\infty}.
    \end{align}
    Therefore, 
    \begin{equation}
        \left\| \mathbb{E}[(\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})^2] \right\|_\infty
        \le 3 \alpha^2 \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_{\infty} + 3 \alpha^2 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 + 3 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}^2] \right\|_\infty,
    \end{equation}
    so, by 27 (specifically 188),
    \begin{align}
        &\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{1}^2] \right\|_\infty  \\
        &\quad\le
            2 \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_\infty 
            \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_\infty 
            + \tfrac2{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 
            \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2
            + 2\left\| \mathbb{E}[(\tfrac{\alpha}{\sqrt{M_2}} \mathbf{W} \mathbf{1} + \mathbf{b})^2] \right\|_\infty, \\
        &\quad\le
            2 \left\| \mathbb{V}_{\text{d}}[\operatorname{vec}(\mathbf{W})] \right\|_\infty 
            (3 \alpha^2 + \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_\infty) 
            + 2\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{W}] \right\|_{\text{F}}^2 
            (3\alpha^2 + \tfrac1{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2)
            + 6 \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{b}^2] \right\|_\infty \\
        &\quad\le
            6 (\sqrt{2} + K)^2(\alpha^2 + 1\lor \left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_\infty)
            + 6K^2 
            (\alpha^2 + \tfrac1{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2).
    \end{align}
    Similarly, by 190, we can write this inequality in terms of $\tfrac1{M_2}\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_1$ instead of $\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_\infty$:
    \begin{align}
        &\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_{1}^2] \right\|_\infty
            \le
            6 (\sqrt{2} + K)^2(\alpha^2 + 1\lor \tfrac1{M_2}\left\| \mathbb{E}[\mathbf{z}_2^2] \right\|_1)
            + 6K^2 
            (\alpha^2 + \tfrac1{M_2} \left\| \mathbb{E}[\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})\phi_2(\mathbf{z}_{2})^{\text{\textsf{T}}}] \right\|_2).
    \end{align}
